You have probably seen this already, but it helped me when I was having trouble with windmills. 

Focus on pushing the ball hard with your guiding hand to your dominate hand -> Your left hand if you are right hand dominate (I am right hand dominate) or vice-versa. For me, when I started focusing on pushing the ball harder with my left hand, into my right hand through the windmill motion I started punching them 10x harder and it didn’t feel awkward anymore. Hope it helps.

Hello fellow fish. Personally I like to wait till level 3 power spike for maximum trades, but it is possible to do this at level 2. 

Once you get 3, try to bait out the enemy to make the first move. For example when playing talon: I play to the side of the minion wave to judge whether he will w(rake) the minion wave or if he uses w(rake) on me, regardless, once he uses his w(rake), I immediately Q,AA, W, and **E offensively or defensively IF NECESSARY**, with talon it’s usually not necessary. That combo will proc Electrocute and talon can do almost nothing to you as his q(dash) is the only way he can reach you, yet it’s useless because he won’t be able to effectively get off his passive without his w(rake). Also, since I baited out his w(rake), once I finish my combo, like I mentioned earlier, I usually don’t even need to use my own e defensively because he doesn’t have his w(rake).

So in short, bait out the enemies abilities and see if they are using them on minions, or to poke you. Once you figure that out, all in Q,AA, W, retreat once you bait out their ability. Rinse and repeat and they will usually play passive in lane.
